title: Program Task Registry
purpose: Establish a universal governed task registry for gaps, bridges, dependencies, validation work, infrastructure, documentation, research debt follow-ups, and promotion candidates across all MPF departments.

constitutional_rules.rule: Program-level tasks SHALL be tracked in a universal Program Task Registry.
Local department tasks MAY remain inside department SSOTs, but cross-department or governance-visible tasks SHALL be registered globally.
Every bridge task SHALL identify all affected departments.
Every task SHALL declare priority, category, status, owner, dependencies, and completion criteria.
A task SHALL NOT be promoted by completion alone; promotion remains governed by claim class and evidence status.
Program tasks SHOULD be computable as a dependency graph.

initial_backfill_tasks.title: Normalize Department Peer Directory Layout
initial_backfill_tasks.summary: Ensure all departments exist as peers under departments/ without structurally privileging any department.
completion_criteria: All active and planned departments have peer directory records.
No department is treated as structurally global by folder location.
initial_backfill_tasks.notes: Backfill task. Current registry records already acknowledge planned peer layout even where directories do not yet exist.

initial_backfill_tasks.title: Create Physics Department SSOT and AGENTS.md
initial_backfill_tasks.summary: Create a local Physics Department SSOT and local AGENTS.md for physical interpretation, correspondence, models, predictions, and validation.
completion_criteria: Physics scope and prohibited promotions are declared.
Physics dependence on mathematics is declared.
initial_backfill_tasks.notes: Current repo state uses departments/physics/physics_ssot.md. This task remains planned because the canonical filename has not yet been normalized to department_ssot.md.

initial_backfill_tasks.title: Separate Mathematics and Physics Claim Routing
initial_backfill_tasks.summary: Prevent formal mathematical derivations from being treated as physical claims and prevent physical interpretations from being treated as mathematical theorems.
completion_criteria: Vector routing policy distinguishes math from physics.
initial_backfill_tasks.notes: Backfill task. The cleanup rule exists in governance, but this task remains planned until the program registry is used as the canonical global tracker.

implementation.note: This patch establishes program-level task tracking without changing existing SSOT structure.
